desc:
Sonic inspired battlegrounds game!
Join community server below for more updates/news!

📱💻🎮 Dive into the world of Chaos Battlegrounds, playable on all devices.
(PC, CONSOLE, MOBILE)
⭐ Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates.

🖥️ Controls:

Left Click - Punch
G - Ultimate Mode
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - Ragdoll Cancel/Evasive
Double Tap W - Run
B - Emote Wheel

Tip: Earn Rings by defeating other players!

⭐ Join our community server to stay updated with exclusive sneaks and exciting news.
